description: This file is the code-behind for the MCQExam ASP.NET page in the Online Examination System. It manages loading multiple-choice questions from a database, session handling, timer management, and recording exam results.

classes.name: MCQExam
classes.description: Code-behind class for managing MCQ examination process for the web page.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles page load event; initializes questions from database based on session; sets timer.

methods.name: submitB_Click
methods.description: Calculates score, saves result to database, and navigates to result page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Handles user logout, navigates to LoginPage.

methods.name: Timer1_Tick
methods.description: Updates countdown timer; indicates time out when countdown finishes.
